Also part 1 says summary includes whether any data was affected. So answer: Yes, summaries indicate whether data was affected; if not, they explicitly state no data was affected. Provide guidance. arguments.message: Each resolved incident on our status page receives a written summary once the investigation is complete. The summary always notes whether any data was affected—if there was no impact, it will explicitly say something like “no data was affected.” You can find this information in the incident’s entry on the status page, where the live updates and the final summary are combined.
